source_cards.title: Spherical Harmonic Sliced Wasserstein Displacement Interpolation for Acoustic Source and Reflection Density Modeling
method: LS, finite-grid NNLS and SOS-SDP reconstruction

reported_experiment.headline: Wasserstein interpolation has lower SSW distance than linear or product interpolation

limitations: target generated by the same SH-ISM simulation family
RIR collapsed over time before comparison
interpolant and headline metric share SSW geometry
simple linear and product baselines only
no uncertainty analysis, measured rooms, listening, localization, peak, mono or mix-context test

source_cards.title: Optimal transport of image sources for interpolation of room impulse responses with moving sources
method: partial optimal transport of image-source positions
explicit RIR NMSE and assignment error
results: POT generally beats linear interpolation except at very high noise
ISM gap to Euclidean assignment is smaller
assignment improvement does not eliminate RIR-NMSE floor when visibility fading is mismodelled
limitations: reported trials use B=250 Hz analytic bandlimit
no measured rooms, full-band rendering, listening, localization or production context

implementation_audits.reading_depth: static full review of SSW transport/distance, PDF validation, SOMS fitting, inverse CDF and related tst scripts
positive_controls: default transport uses NNLS_MSq plus SDP
SOMS/PSD reconstruction represents globally non-negative fields in principle
findings: sh_pdf_check explicitly omits non-negativity and checks only real field plus unity integral
cond(A_mat) is printed but not gated; no condition gate for square SH evaluation matrix
CVX solution is consumed without cvx_status check
transport calls sh_fit_msq with is_pdf=false and normalizes afterward
inverse CDF returns last iterate without post-loop convergence assertion or failure flag
reviewed tst scripts contain plots and timings but no assertions or matlab.unittest checks
optional exponential weighting has possible multi-time indexing and normalization defects requiring execution
tutorial exp_k=0.1 conflicts with caption k=0.5

knowledge_cards.claim: RIR-duration aggregation removes delay structure and cannot validate early-reflection timing or temporal echo density.
An SSW-built method evaluated mainly by SSW needs an independent time-domain or perceptual metric.
Simulated SH-ISM output is a model reference, not physical ground truth.
Unconstrained LS-SSW may be negative; denser sampling reduces but does not eliminate negative regions.
Finite-grid NNLS non-negativity is not a global guarantee; SOMS/PSD is stronger.
PSD/SOMS structure still needs solver-status, normalization, finite-value and held-out-grid checks.
Current sh_pdf_check verifies real field and unity integral, not non-negativity.
Printed condition numbers are diagnostics, not safety gates.
Returning the last inverse-CDF iterate without convergence status can silently propagate error.
Demo scripts with figures and timings are not regression tests.
Optional weighting requires hand-reference normalization and multi-time regression tests.
Improved image-source assignment can coexist with an RIR-error floor under a mismatched visibility/fading model.

handoff: Aggregate SSW reflection density is a diagnostic candidate, not proof of a better moving reverb. Keep timing and direction separately observable; fail closed on solver/CDF/conditioning faults; keep raw safety renders separate from loudness-matched blind copies; do not enable exponential slice weighting before a hand-reference regression.
